name: YKT Corporation
summary: YKT Corporation operates as a global machinery trading firm, specializing in the import and export of a diverse range of products. This extensive portfolio includes electronic equipment, precision machine tools, various measuring instruments, welding machinery, and general industrial machinery, serving markets both within Japan and internationally. Furthermore, the company supplies specialized mounting equipment, encompassing devices for semiconductor mounting and bonding. Its offerings also provide solutions across numerous manufacturing applications, such as the production of tools, dies and molds, components, medical parts, and turbine blades. Additionally, it supports quality control, measurement, inspection, and broader machinery and equipment production. Established in 1924, YKT Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
